description: Parallactic angle correction for MeerKAT measurement sets

parameters.info: Use special ephemeris body as defined in PyEphem
parameters.name: specialEphem

parameters.info: Simulate only; make no modifications to database
parameters.name: simulate

parameters.info: Parallactic angle correction step size in minutes
parameters.name: parangstep

parameters.info: Apply anti-diagonal matrix; flips the visibility hands
parameters.name: applyantidiag

parameters.info: Override the receptor angle stored in FEED for all antennae
parameters.name: overridefeedangle

parameters.info: Column to store corrected data to; default CORRECTED_DATA - must exist
parameters.name: storecolumn

parameters.info: Column to read uncorrected data from; default DATA - must exist
parameters.name: rawcolumn

parameters.info: Apply no parallactic angle derotation; useful only to apply feedflip matrix
parameters.name: noparang

parameters.info: Apply parallactic angle corruption instead of correction
parameters.name: invertPA
